retrievalProfile.description: A dark, ornate Art Nouveau composition featuring a central group portrait encased in complex golden filigree and copper-plate calligraphy.
triggerTerms: vintage group portrait with wood paneling

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic portrait of four men with theatrical bruising, framed by an intricate, symmetrical Art Nouveau border of golden swirling lines against a dark chocolate background.
coreVisualRelationships: The ornate border acts as a window into a dimly lit, wood-paneled interior.
The golden filigree color echoes the warm highlights on the subjects' skin and clothing.
The sweeping curves of the typography integrate seamlessly with the decorative border elements.
The subjects' disheveled appearance contrasts with the formal, rigid elegance of the framing.
coreInvariants: Dark, desaturated color palette with warm wood tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men in mid-to-close-up shots, arranged in a staggered group within the central 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, flourishing initial letter of the top text which breaks the upper border line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top decorative script, follow the circular filigree border down, and settle on the central group's faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark brown outer margin provides a heavy, grounded base for the golden line work.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep chocolate brown and charcoal (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Antique gold and copper (filigree and typography)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds and ochres (clothing and makeup details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the thin golden lines and the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme ascender and descender flourishes that morph into filigree
Variable stroke width with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capitals feature oversized loops that overlap the inner frame
Lowercase 's' and 'r' have extended tails that integrate into the border scrollwork

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the top edge of the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller script at the bottom mimics the style of the primary display text for a cohesive, framed look.

avoid: Standard cursive fonts without custom swashes

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the correct base skeleton for high-contrast script
Captures the dramatic flourishes and elegant weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image of four men in 1970s-style suits with bruised faces, standing against a dark wood-paneled wall. Surround this with a thick dark brown margin and an intricate, symmetrical golden Art Nouveau filigree border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom copperplate-style lettering in gold at the top and bottom. Ensure the top lettering has large flourishes that overlap the inner gold frame.

verificationChecks: Is the border symmetrical and Art Nouveau in style?
Do the letters have extreme, decorative swashes?
Is the color palette restricted to dark browns and golds?
Is the central image a group portrait with a vintage feel?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the golden metallic sheen
Width of the outer dark margin
mustRedesign: The specific faces of the individuals
The exact wording of the text

mustAchieve: Moody, low-key lighting in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check that the filigree does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Ensure the text is legible despite the heavy flourishes.
Verify the square aspect ratio is maintained.
Confirm the lighting on the subjects matches the warm gold of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Group Portrait] + [Style: 1970s Vintage] + [Frame: Art Nouveau Filigree] + [Typography: Flourished Copperplate Script] + [Palette: Chocolate and Gold].
